name: Parties and Agreement Date
text: THIS AGREEMENT is made this 25 day of February, 2011, by and between Axia NetMedia Corporation, a corporation organized under the laws of the Province of Alberta, Canada (‘Guarantor’) and Massachusetts Technology Park Corporation, an independent public _ instrumentality of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, established, organized, and existing pursuant to Chapter 40] of the Massachusetts General Laws and doing business as the Massachusetts Technology Collaborative, together with its successors and assigns ("MTC"),

name: Network Operator and Network Operator Agreement Definitions
text: WHEREAS, MTC and Axia NGNetworks USA, Inc., a Delaware company registered in Massachusetts and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Guarantor (“Network Operator”), are considering entering into a Master Agreement for a network operator (the "Network Operator Agreement"), pursuant-to which Network Operator would agree to perform certain network operator services and to undertake certain financial, operational and other responsibilities relating to the MassBroadband 123 fiber optic network MTC is planning to constract, all as more specifically defined in the Network Operator Agreement; and

name: Guarantee for MTC's Benefit
text: WHEREAS, in order to enhance the security sought by MTC of the Network Operator, Guarantor agrees to issue this guarantee for the direct benefit of MTC as provided herein.

name: 1.1 Guarantor Representation and Warranty
text: 1.1 Guarantor hereby represents and wartants that Guarantor is a validly existing corporation with full power, authority and legal right to enter into and perform this Agreement,

name: 2.1 Guaranteed Obligations
text: 2.1 | Guarantor does hereby guarantee to MTC and its successors and assigns that, should Network Operator default in any of its payment or performance obligations under the Network Operator Agreement, Guarantor, on behalf of Network Operator, (a) shall make all such payments and perform all such obligations of the Network Operator, as described in and in accordance with the terms of the Network Operator Agreement, and as such obligations may be changed in accordance with the terms of the Network Operator Agreement (the "Guaranteed Obligations"); and (b) shall fully and punctually pay and discharge, as the same become due and payable, any and all costs, expenses and liabilities for or in connection with the Guaranteed Obligations, including, but not limited to, the costs of causing the substituted performance of the Guaranteed Obligations.

name: 2.1 Liability Cap
text: This guatanty is limited to and capped at the amount of Four Million ($4,000,000) US Dollars,

name: 2.1 Exhaustion of Guarantor's Liability
text: and should Guarantor advance to MTC funds up to said amount, Guarantor shall have no further obligation or liability under this Agreement,

name: 2.2 Continuing Guaranty
text: 2.2 This Agreement shall be a continuing, absolute and unconditional (except as noted in section 2.1 above) guaranty and shall remain in full force and effect until all obligations of Network Operator under the Network Operator Agreement have been fulfilled, irrespective of the bankruptcy, insolvency, merger, reorganization, termination, ‘discontinuance or dissolution of Network Operator, or any assignment for the benofit of creditors by Network Operator.

name: 2.3 Unaffected Liability
text: 2.3 This Agreement and the liability hereunder shall not be affected or impaired by any compromise, settlement, release, renewal, extension, indulgence, change in or modification of any of the obligations and liabilities of Network Operator under the Network Operator Agreement, or by any failure on the part of MTC, its successors or assigns, to realize upon any obligations or liabilities of Network Operator.

name: 2.4 Events Not Affecting Guarantor's Duties
text: 2.4 Without limiting the scope of this Agreement as set forth above, The obligations, covenants, agreements and duties of the Guarantor under this Agreement shall not be affected or impaired by reason of the happening fiom time to time of any of the following with respect to the Network Operator Agreement or this Agreement: . A, The waiver by MTC of the performance or observance by Network Operator, Guarantor of any of the agreements, covenants, terms or coniditions contained in the Network Operator Agreement or other documents executed in connection therewith; B. The extension of the time for the performance by the Network Operator of any obligations under the Network Operator Agreement or of any other obligations under or arising out of any the Network Operator Agreement or the extension or the renewal of the same; or | C, The modification or amendment (whether material or otherwise) of any duty, agreement or obligation of Network Operator set forth in the Network Operator Agreement,

name: 2.5 Direct Proceeding Against Guarantor
text: 2.5 In an Event of Default (as defined below) MTC, or its successors and assigns, shall have the right to proceed directly against the Guarantor.

name: 2.5 Guarantor's Right to Cure
text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Guaranty or the Network Operator Agreement, in the event that a default of Network Operator occurs and is continuing under the Network Operator Agreement, Guarantor shall have the right to ’ cure such default within the time period, if any, provided Network Operator in the Network Operator Agreement.

name: 2.5 Acceptance of Guarantor's Cure
text: In the event that Guarantor cures such default within such period, MTC shall accept such cure by Guarantor as if Network Operator had performed same,

name: 2.6 Waiver of Notices and Approval Rights
text: 2.6 Guarantor hereby waives presentment for payment, notice of demand, notice of nonpayment or dishonor, protest, notice of protest, and all other notices in connection with the delivery, acceptance, performance, or default under the Network Operator Agreement, and hereby waives all notice or right of approval of any extensions, renewals, modifications or forbearances which may be allowed,

name: 2.6 Notice of Network Operator Default
text: Guarantor shall be entitled to and shall receive contemporaneous notice by MTC of any default declared by MTC of the Network Operator under the Network Operator -2- Agreement

name: 2.6 Effect of Delayed Default Notice
text: but any neglect or dolay on the part of MTC in giving such notice shall only postpone the time for performance of, and shall not diminish or discharge, Guarantor's obligations hereunder.

name: 3.1 Cumulative Remedies
text: 3,1 No remedy herein conferred or reserved is intended to be exclusive of any other available remedy or remedies, if any, but each and every such remedy shall be cumulative and shall be in addition to every other remedy given under this Agreement or now or hereafter existing at law or in equity or by statute.

name: 3.1 Delay or Omission Not a Waiver
text: No delay or omission to exercise any right or power accruing upon any default, omission or failure of performance hereunder shall impair any such right or power or shall be construed to be a waiver thereof,

name: 3.1 Repeated Exercise of Rights
text: but any such right and power may be exercised from time to time and as often as may be deemed expedient,

name: 3.1 Limited Effect of Waiver
text: In the event any provision contained in this Agreement should be breached by any party and thereafter duly waived by the other party so empowered to act, such waiver shall be limited to the particular breach so waived and shall not be deemed to be a waiver of any other breach hereunder,

name: 3.2 Events of Default
text: 3.2 The occurrence of one or more of the following shall constitute an Event of Default and entitle MTC to the remedies provided herein: A, The Network Operator fails to cure any default under the Network Operator Agreement within the time for cure specified therein, or if no cure period is specified, then within thirty (30) days after receiving notice of default from MTC to Network Operator under the Network Operator Agreement; B, Network Operator is adjudicated a bankrupt, or a trustee or receiver is appointed for Network Operator for all or a substantial part of its property by an involuntary proceeding, or Network Operator files a petition in bankruptcy or an answer not denying jurisdiction in bankruptcy, or if Network Operator makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or if Network Operator becomes insolvent.

name: 4.1 Binding Effect and Successors
text: 4,1 This Agreement and every part thereof shall be binding upon, and imure to the benefit of Guarantor, Network Operator and MTC, and their respective successors and assigns.

name: 4.2 Severability
text: 4.2 Incase any one or more of the covenants, agreements, terms or provisions contained in this Agreement shall be invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect, the validity of the remaining covenants, agreements, terms or provisions contained herein shall be in no way affected, prejudiced or disturbed thereby,

name: 4.3 Currency and Funds
text: 4.3 Currency of Payments. Any and all amounts required to be paid by Guarantor hereunder shall be paid to MTC in lawful money of the United States of America and in immediately available funds to MTC.

name: 4.3 Written Notice of Payments
text: Guarantor agrees that whenever, at any time, or from time to 3. time, it shall make any payment to MTC on account of its Jiability hereunder, it will notify MTC in writing that such payment is made under this Guaranty for that purpose.

name: 44 Written Amendments and Waivers
text: 44 Amendments. No amendment or waiver of any provision of this Guaranty nor consent fo any departure by Guarantor therefrom shall in any event be effective unless the same shall be in writing and signed by MTC,

name: 44 Limited Effect of Waiver or Consent
text: and then such waiver or consent shall be effective only in the specific instance and for the specific purpose for which given.

name: 4.5 Notice Requirements and Addresses
text: 4.5 Notices. All notices and other communications which may be or are desired to be given hereunder shall be in writing, sent via overnight courier or personally delivered, and addressed to the following addresses: If to Guarantor: | Axia NetMedia Corporation 3300 450 Ist Street SW Calgary, AB T2P 5H1 CANADA Attn: Legal Department Ifto MTC: Massachusetts Technology Collaborative 75 North Drive Westborough, MA 01581 USA Attn: Executive Director with a copy to: Philip F.-Holahan | Deputy Executive Director and General Counsel Massachusetts Technology Collaborative 75 North Drive Westborough, MA 01581 or as to each party at such other address as shall be designated by such party in a written notice to each other party complying as to delivery with the terms of this Section 4.5,

name: 4.5 Effectiveness of Notices
text: All such notices and other communications shall be effective the business day following the date sent delivered via overnight courier, or the date personally delivered, addressed as aforesaid.

name: 4.6 Governing Law
text: 4.6 Governing Law, Jurisdiction, Venue and Forum, This Guaranty shall be governed by, construed in and enforced in accordance exclusively with the laws of the State of 4. Massachusetts.

name: Section 4.6 — Arbitration Prerequisite
text: If the parties fail to resolve any dispute between them through mediation, or are unable to convene mediation within 60 days of first attempting to do so, then, at MTC’s sole election, MTC may file a demand for arbitration by the American Arbitration Association in its office serving Boston, Massachusetts, in accordance with the rules for Commercial Arbitration in effect on the date of the Agreement providing the most expedited procedures available,

name: Section 4.6 — Litigation Forum
text: Except to the extent MTC elects arbitration as the method of dispute resolution for a given dispute, all disputes shall be resolved by litigation in a court serving Middlesex County, Massachusetts,

name: Section 4.6 — Incorporation by Reference
text: All other provisions relating to dispute resolution or arbitration contained in the Network Operator Agreement are incorporated herein by reference.
